 Choosing Capgemini means choosing a company where you will be empowered to shape your career in the way you’d like, where you’ll be supported and inspired by a collaborative community of colleagues around the world, and where you’ll be able to reimagine what’s possible. Join us and help the world’s leading organizations unlock the value of technology and build a more sustainable, more inclusive world.
 Your Role
 As a Junior Python Developer with Capgemini, you will contribute to the development, maintenance, and support of software solutions while building your technical expertise in Python development. Working under the guidance of senior team members, you will participate in delivering high-quality software components, supporting integration activities, and learning best practices within a collaborative and international environment.
 In this role you will:
Develop, maintain, and document software components based on functional and technical specifications.
Implement application features using Python and related frameworks, following coding standards and development guidelines.
Assist in the development and integration of APIs, backend services, and interoperability components.
Create and execute unit tests, support testing activities, and help identify and resolve software defects.
Participate in code reviews and apply feedback to improve code quality and development practices.
Contribute to the preparation and maintenance of technical documentation, including user guides, technical specifications, and operational procedures.
Support system deployment, configuration, and maintenance activities throughout the software development lifecycle.
Troubleshoot application issues and work with team members to identify and implement solutions.
Collaborate with developers, testers, business analysts, and other stakeholders within Agile teams.
Continuously develop technical skills and stay up to date with modern Python technologies and development practices.
 Your Profile
Basic to intermediate knowledge of Python programming language and interest in building enterprise applications.
Familiarity with Python frameworks such as Django, Flask, or FastAPI is considered an advantage.
Understanding of software development principles, object-oriented programming concepts, and coding best practices.
Basic knowledge of REST APIs, web services, and application integration concepts.
Familiarity with relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, Oracle) and SQL fundamentals.
Understanding of version control systems such as Git.
 Knowledge of Agile methodologies and software development lifecycle concepts.
Familiarity with testing frameworks such as PyTest or UnitTest is considered an asset.
Exposure to cloud technologies (Azure, AWS, GCP), Docker, or CI/CD tools is considered an advantage.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and learning abilities.
Good communication skills and ability to work effectively in team-oriented and multicultural environments.
Minimum 2 years of overall IT experience, including at least 1 year of hands-on experience in Python development and related frameworks.
Excellent communication skills in French and English.
